items.title: 'Sandworm' Chains Cisco Vulnerabilities to Deploy Cyclops Blink

items.title: Microsoft releases emergency Windows updates to fix RDS failures
items.description: Microsoft has released emergency out-of-band Windows updates to fix Remote Desktop Services failures caused by this month's security updates, along with Hyper-V and USB audio problems on some Windows versions. [...]

items.title: Japan's Digital Agency says VPN flaw exposed 246,000 personnel records
items.description: Japan's Digital Agency has discovered a data breach that may have exposed around 246,000 record rows containing personal information of government employees. [...]

items.title: Maximum Severity GitLab Flaw Puts Supply Chains at Risk
items.description: CVE-2026-85706 is a path traversal vulnerability with a 10 out of 10 CVSS score, affecting both GitLab Community Edition and Enterprise Edition instances.

items.title: Homebrew 7.0.0 gets built-in GUI, better security controls
items.description: Homebrew package manager version 7.0.0 has been released with a built-in vulnerability scanner, stronger security controls, and the full release of its native BrewUI graphical interface. [...]

items.title: Twitch extension with 30K installs exposes users’ OAuth tokens
items.description: A browser extension called Twitch Enhanced Viewer | JeetBot, available in the official Chrome and Firefox stores, sends users' Twitch OAuth session tokens to a commercial bot service. [...]

items.title: Hackers hijack HBO Max Reddit account to push malware in ClickFix ads
items.description: Hackers compromised HBO Max's official Reddit account and used it to push malicious ads that launched ClickFix attacks to infect Windows and macOS devices with information-stealing malware. [...]

items.description: Researchers have disclosed a new hardware attack, called DDRop, that breaks the memory protection in Intel and AMD confidential computing by silently dropping writes to a server's memory, so the processor keeps reading old encrypted data as if it were current. items.description: An attacker was operating inside the network of 3BB, one of Thailand's largest broadband providers, and maintained remote control of internal machines using a legitimate management tool called MeshCentral, threat intelligence firm Hunt.io said. items.title: Telegram Desktop Flaw Lets Hidden JavaScript Exfiltrate Messages From HTML Exports
items.description: A flaw in Telegram Desktop let a bot's message plant hidden JavaScript inside chats that users exported to HTML files, security researchers at ExPatch said in a writeup published on September 12. items.title: Hackers Exploit FortiGate SSL-VPN Vulnerability to Attack Broadband Provider
items.description: Researchers have uncovered an exposed attacker-controlled staging server containing evidence of a wide-ranging intrusion targeting 3BB, the consumer brand operated by Thailand’s Triple T Broadband. The investigation links the operation to the exploitation of a critical SSL-VPN vulnerability, followed by privilege escalation, credential theft, internal reconnaissance, lateral movement, and…

items.title: Hackers Mass-Scan Exposed Vite Servers to Steal AWS and Azure Cloud Credentials
items.description: Hackers are conducting a large-scale automated scanning campaign against internet-exposed Vite development servers, attempting to steal AWS credentials, Azure access tokens, environment variables, and Infrastructure-as-Code secrets. F5 honeypot sensors recorded 807 session-grouped attacks and about 32,000 raw events in August 2026, a sharp increase from only 1,732 Vite-related file-read events…

items.title: Red Heron Exploits Gitea RCE to Compromise 13 Organizations Across Six Countries
items.description: A suspected Chinese threat actor tracked as Red Heron has been attributed to the rapid exploitation of a recently disclosed security vulnerability in Gitea to compromise internet-facing instances as part of a multi-national campaign. items.title: UK Government Begins Moving 23 Million Users Away From Passwords
items.description: The UK government has begun rolling out passkeys across GOV.UK One Login, offering more than 23 million users a passwordless way to access public services. The deployment covers everything from childcare support and driving license renewals to State Pension checks and tax management, significantly changing how citizens authenticate to government systems. items.title: Anthropic CEO: Time to Shift From Improving to Controlling AI
items.description: Dario Amodei says it's time to slow the pace of frontier AI improvements so that security and risk prevention efforts can catch up. What does this mean for enterprises?

items.title: Nintendo Switch Vulnerability Allows Attackers to Run Unauthorized Code on Your Console
items.description: Nintendo has patched a high-severity vulnerability in the original Nintendo Switch that could let a nearby attacker execute unauthorized code and access information stored on the console. Tracked as CVE-2026-82079, the flaw affects firmware earlier than 23.0.0 and resides in local wireless networking. The security issue is a stack-based buffer overflow, a memory-corruption weakness that […] The…

items.title: Microsoft Offers Up to $30,000 for Critical AI Flaws in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform
items.description: Microsoft is offering security researchers up to $30,000 for finding critical AI vulnerabilities in Dynamics 365 and Power Platform, sharpening its focus on flaws that could manipulate AI inference or expose information through model behavior. The program covers qualifying bugs in Microsoft-hosted services and third-party or open-source components embedded in them, provided researchers…

items.description: WordPress has announced it's launching an automated security review for every release of a plugin before it's distributed through the WordPress.org update API so as to analyze it for potential security issues and ensure there are no risks involved. items.description: China’s Ministry of Foreign Affairs responded to a question about Amodei’s essay by saying that all parties should work together on AI. The post Beijing Hits Back at Anthropic CEO’s Call to Curb China’s AI Development appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: New Warnings About the Risks of AI to Humanity Revive a Long-Running Debate
items.description: Concerns over the potential risks of the technology are rising as new AI models become more powerful, heightening both the potential for misuse by people with criminal aims. items.description: The company unintentionally disclosed users’ information to a third party impersonating a government agency. The post Personal, Financial Info Exposed in Revolut Data Breach appeared first on SecurityWeek.

items.title: The Race to Control AI and Protect What Makes Us Human
